WITH date_window AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           MIN(CASE WHEN d_date = DATE '2001-05-02' THEN d_date_sk END) OVER () AS boundary_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-04-02' AND DATE '2001-06-01'
),
filtered_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cs.cs_order_number,
           cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
           cs.cs_sales_price,
           cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
           dw.boundary_sk
    FROM item i
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
    JOIN date_window dw
        ON dw.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
sales_with_returns AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT fs.cs_order_number,
           fs.cs_item_sk,
           fs.cs_warehouse_sk,
           fs.cs_sales_price,
           fs.cs_sold_date_sk,
           fs.boundary_sk,
           cr.cr_refunded_cash
    FROM filtered_sales fs
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = fs.cs_order_number
       AND cr.cr_item_sk = fs.cs_item_sk
),
fact_agg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT fs.cs_warehouse_sk,
           fs.cs_item_sk,
           CASE WHEN fs.cs_sold_date_sk < fs.boundary_sk THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS bucket,
           SUM(fs.cs_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(COALESCE(fs.cr_refunded_cash, 0)) AS refund
    FROM sales_with_returns fs
    GROUP BY fs.cs_warehouse_sk, fs.cs_item_sk,
             CASE WHEN fs.cs_sold_date_sk < fs.boundary_sk THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END
)
SELECT w.w_state,
       i.i_item_id,
       COALESCE(SUM(fa.sales) FILTER (WHERE fa.bucket = 'before'), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(fa.refund) FILTER (WHERE fa.bucket = 'before'), 0) AS sales_before,
       COALESCE(SUM(fa.sales) FILTER (WHERE fa.bucket = 'after'), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(fa.refund) FILTER (WHERE fa.bucket = 'after'), 0) AS sales_after
FROM fact_agg fa
JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = fa.cs_warehouse_sk
JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = fa.cs_item_sk
   AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
GROUP BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
ORDER BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100

THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash,0) ELSE 0 END)` expressions — TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite each as `SUM(cs_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE bucket) - SUM(COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash,0)) FILTER (WHERE bucket)` so the sales and refund sums are computed independently over the same filtered rows while preserving the before/after split.

5. DIMENSION JOIN AND SORT LAST — TARGET: final `GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id LIMIT 100` — TRANSFORMATION: First aggregate the reduced fact/return rows by `(cs_warehouse_sk, cs_item_sk, bucket)`, then join to the 5-row `warehouse` and small filtered `item` set, and only then apply the final group/sort/limit on a tiny aggregated result.

raw_sql: select w_state ,i_item_id ,sum(case when (cast(d_date as date) < cast ('2001-05-02' as date)) then cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash,0) else 0 end) as sales_before ,sum(case when (cast(d_date as date) >= cast ('2001-05-02' as date)) then cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash,0) else 0 end) as sales_after from catalog_sales left outer join catalog_returns on (cs_order_number = cr_order_number and cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk) ,warehouse ,item ,date_dim where i_current_price between 0.99 and 1.49 and i_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk and cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast('2001-04-02' as date) and cast('2001-06-01' as date) group by w_state,i_item_id order by w_state,i_item_id limit 100
